about: The views' scenarios (berry/panel_ui.be): each starts from a fresh berry/test/fixtures/living-room.json, and each step has every effect it must give. Steps are written by hand; the effects are recorded by node berry/test/run.mjs --update-vectors when a change is meant, and the diff is its review.
items: Asks for a pattern to open Settings.

scenarios.name: the Middle's screen, a device, the next page and back
a device's name: its options, and renamed by its hold
a counter toggles its kind, a kind without power does nothing, and Settings opens the options
a zone's options: its button mark taken off, and a delete that asks first
a zone's colour: the picker on the plan's page, a dot, and the title calling it off
a zone's display: Summary chosen, then Places back
a device's options, its type, and removing it, confirmed
Settings by the swipe down: a switch, its Help, and back
button 2 relinked: the marks go, after the confirmation
expect: The marks on 4 zones are cleared.

scenarios.name: Screens from the plan's title, and a new screen by its +
a grid typed on the keyboard: refused, then taken
a place typed that another device holds: the swap asked, called off, then taken
the Hall's +: Zigbee device, whose search starts as its screen opens, and called off
the Hall's +: a relay device, on relay 1, which already switches the Hall's; relay 2, which powers the lamps, says Zigbee only; a Switch chosen, and the check makes it
a lamp found in the Hall with relay 2 marked is powered by it, and without power when it opens
a lamp found in the Hall with relay 1 marked hangs on no relay: relay 1 switches the Hall's relay devices
a lamp's options: the relay that powers it, taken off
a lamp's detail, and the Middle's joint mode by its counter, each renamed by its title
the Hall's relay only switches: its icon held opens nothing, its name its options and its Info
with Editing off, the options shrink and the + goes
a pattern made in Settings: too short, not the same, then twice, and Settings behind it
five wrong tries make a wait, and five more after it a wait twice as long
the pattern's options: a change called off, and a removal, confirmed
a search in the Hall: seven lamps for six places, the grid filling, and the models
a lamp's report reaches the zone's screen that lists it, and only that one
a relay moved: the zone's screen with what it switches or feeds draws again, not under its keyboard
the zone's list keeps its page through a counter, its joint mode and its options
a search that finds nothing, searched again, and called off
the right pattern opens Settings after 24.8 days of uptime, when millis() has turned negative
a wait nobody looked at again does not come back when the clock wraps, 24.8 days after it ended
a double tap on Delete zone does not answer the question it opens, and a tap a moment later does
a search left open when the screensaver comes ends with it, and its seconds stop
a find being renamed keeps its keyboard through the search's seconds
the screensaver's times: the first chosen from its list, then the second on its next page
a swipe on Main settings: up to the next page and on, nothing past the last, down back, nothing before the first
Main settings' Info: what runs on the panel, a fact a row, and a tap on one does nothing
Wireless settings by the swipe up, with no network: Connect has the web setup, which opens, says where the phone goes, and stops
expect: On your phone, join tasmota-3E51A7-6960, then open 192.168.4.1.
On your phone, join tasmota-3E51A7-6960, then open 192.168.4.1.

scenarios.name: connected: the network, its signal and address; Disconnect asked first, then off, and Reconnect
expect: The bridge's lamps, the web page and updates stop until you reconnect.

scenarios.name: Forget network, confirmed: the Wi-Fi is drawn after it, with nothing saved
expect: The panel restarts without Wi-Fi, and the web page and updates stop.

scenarios.name: the pattern stands in front of Wireless settings too, and drawn there it opens Wireless settings
with Zigbee off, the + of a zone offers only the relay device, and its check makes a light on relay 1
the Wi-Fi comes up with its view on show: drawn again from its first page, and nothing under a view of the zones
the Hall's + opens with the network closed: an announce before the Zigbee device is chosen is nobody's, and choosing it starts the search

Search networks, with the station driver: the search runs, what it found is listed with the saved one marked, a network with a password asks for it, and a join that works closes the way in down to the Wi-Fi
A join that fails says why, Try again brings back what was typed, and Back leaves it behind
A password shorter than 8 is refused before any join, and an open network is tried at once
Other network: a hidden network by its name, then its password, and the refresh of the header searches again
With the driver, a saved network that does not come up says why, and Change password asks for it again
With the driver in the mesh, Disconnect keeps the lamps, and Forget turns the Wi-Fi off with no restart
expect: The web page, updates and Home Assistant stop until you reconnect.
The Wi-Fi turns off, and the web page and updates stop.

scenarios.name: The Hotspot from the Wi-Fi: opened with a password drawn, its QR with the name, the password, the address and whether a phone is on it, and Stop closes it with no restart
With the station driver, the Web setup is the hotspot on Tasmota's Wi-Fi page, and stops with no restart
A hotspot that closed after 15 min with nobody on it: its view says so, and the Wi-Fi row no longer says it is on
expect: It closed after 15 min with nobody on it.

scenarios.name: MQTT from Wireless settings: the broker and what the panel says to it, the battery timeout with it, edited as a draft, and Save asks first, the panel restarting
expect: The panel restarts to connect to 192.168.2.20.

scenarios.name: MQTT off: no broker says so, and in a house the setting is the house's, which Save asks first
expect: The panel restarts with MQTT off.

scenarios.name: Backup from Wireless settings: no server until the house has one, the backup it takes, what it carried a tap away, and Back up now after a failure
expect: 30/09 14:02, at the night's round. 5 zones and 34 devices, on Home Assistant.

scenarios.name: Backup: this panel's own on the server, kept with nothing to save, and Restore asks first with what it brings
expect: From 29/09 18:30: 5 zones, 34 devices and the settings, in place of this panel's. It restarts.

scenarios.name: Backup: nothing on the server, Restore looks again; and on the US portrait, its list with the value under the name

Add to this house: the search over ESP-NOW, the nodes by signal with the nearest bridge marked, one of an older build takes no tap, a panel says so, the bridge asked to blink, Yes, the welcome, and an adding that worked goes back to where it started
expect: Its light blinks fast once it hears the panel.
Its light blinks fast. Yes adds it, No goes back to the list.

scenarios.name: An adding that did not pair says why, and the refresh searches again
Add to this house without a network: the search goes over ESP-NOW, and needs none, listening on every channel
Add to this house with the Hotspot up: the glass says it closes first, Cancel keeps it, and Continue closes it for the search
expect: The Hotspot closes to search for the nodes.
The Hotspot closes to search for the nodes.

scenarios.name: A zone's + with the house's bridge out of step offers only the relay device
The Wi-Fi an adding offers: the bridge's, used, and joined, and Done goes back to where it started
expect: Its light blinks fast. Yes adds it, No goes back to the list.
The panel is on the bridge's Wi-Fi.

scenarios.name: The Wi-Fi an adding offers: this panel's, given to a bridge with none, and no word back
expect: It has none. It joins Cottage.
Its address shows in the house in a minute.

scenarios.name: A lamp the panel still has, reset and on another bridge's network: the + takes it back to its place, and it blinks and joins its groups again
On the US portrait, Wireless settings, the Wi-Fi and Main settings are on its one list, the value under the name: every list, since 2026-10-17
On the US portrait, the web setup opens on the QR's page: the code joins the open network, the lines say the rest, and Stop stops it
The Wi-Fi QR escapes what the format asks, and refuses what the glass cannot carry
With the driver, Web setup three minutes after the pattern asks for it again, and drawn it opens the hotspot
With the driver, Hotspot three minutes after the pattern asks for it again, and drawn it opens the hotspot
A lamp found in the Hall and the search closed before its interview: the interview still puts it in its place, and it blinks
A hotspot that closed for the Wi-Fi Manager, and one that lost the radio: its view says why
expect: The Wi-Fi Manager took the radio.

scenarios.name: Main settings' Factory reset: the destructive confirmation, and the brain's reset
expect: The zones, the devices, the Wi-Fi and the MQTT are erased, and it leaves the house. The screen stays. It restarts.

scenarios.name: a page this side loaded and drew on is not drawn again by its own load event, and a load that nobody drew on is
a load event that came after the echo's time is not one: the page is drawn
the swipe down to Main settings, on the page the glass loaded, writes only what the page does not start with; the next page writes it all
